title: eCommerce System Map
description: Interactive map of catalog eCommerce models, checkout flow, and module capabilities. Pan, zoom, and click nodes for details.

help.title: About the eCommerce system map
help.overview: The system map is a read-only picture of the catalog eCommerce module: every model and how they reference each other, the main flows step by step, and what the module offers. It changes no data. The marketplace has its own map.

sections.title: Model graph
sections.body: The default tab: the data model, grouped into catalog, ordering, payments, point of sale, escrow, and shared clusters.
items: Pan and zoom, or use the zoom and fit controls. Filter by cluster when the full map is too much.
Click a node to see its description, key fields, API path, actions, and the panel page that manages it.
Edges show which model points at which; bridge edges cross into the finance module.

sections.title: How it works
sections.body: Flows tell the story in order rather than as a list of models.
items: Catalog and merchandising, inventory, cart → checkout → order, post-purchase operations, point of sale, and the Odoo import each have their own flow.
Dashed steps are the way back, such as a failed shipment or an expired checkout.

sections.title: Capabilities
sections.body: What the module covers, so you can find where a job belongs.
items: Lists the features, the API areas, the scheduled jobs, and the public storefront routes.
Catalog settings such as categories, warehouses, discounts, tills, and fiscal configs live under Configurations, not in this menu; the map still shows them.
